providers.name: TikTok for Developers
notes: Display API v2 (user/info, video/list, video/query) only returns data about the TikTok user who authorized the app through Login Kit; it cannot search TikTok or read other users' videos.
Scopes must be approved for the app AND granted by each user; users can grant a subset. user.info.basic is added by default for Login Kit apps.
Access tokens last 24 hours; refresh tokens about 365 days.
cover_image_url values have a 6-hour TTL; refresh them with Query Videos.
Content Posting API: unaudited clients may post only SELF_ONLY content to private accounts, for at most 5 users per 24 hours, until the app passes TikTok's audit.
Sandbox mode allows up to 10 target users and does not provide Content Posting API access for public videos.
Research API and Commercial Content API are separate, approval-only products (Research: approved non-commercial researchers in eligible regions).
Responses use the envelope {data, error{code, message, log_id}}; error.code is "ok" on success.

endpoints.title: Get User Info
endpoints.description: Returns profile information about the TikTok user who authorized the app (the owner of the access token). It cannot look up other users. Each requested field needs a specific scope: open_id, union_id, avatar URLs and display_name need user.info.basic; bio_description, profile_deep_link, is_verified and username need user.info.profile; follower_count, following_count, likes_count and video_count need user.info.stats.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of user fields to return. Field-to-scope mapping: user.info.basic = open_id, union_id, avatar_url, avatar_url_100, avatar_large_url, display_name; user.info.profile = bio_description, profile_deep_link, is_verified, username; user.info.stats = follower_count, following_count, likes_count, video_count. Request only fields whose scope the user granted.

authentication.description: Requires a user access token obtained through Login Kit (OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow). The app must be approved for the listed scope(s) AND the signed-in TikTok user must grant them; users may grant only a subset of the requested scopes. Access tokens last 24 hours and are renewed with a refresh token (valid about 365 days). Only the scope matching each requested field is needed (see the fields parameter).

rateLimits.description: 600 requests per one-minute sliding window; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with error code rate_limit_exceeded.

responseFields.description: Response data.
User object for the authorized user.
Unique ID of the user within the current app (scope user.info.basic).
Persistent ID of the user across apps from the same developer (scope user.info.basic).
Profile image URL (scope user.info.basic).
Profile image URL at 100x100 (scope user.info.basic).
Higher-resolution profile image URL (scope user.info.basic).
Profile name (scope user.info.basic).
Bio text, if a valid one exists (scope user.info.profile).
Link to the user's TikTok profile page (scope user.info.profile).
Whether TikTok has verified the account (scope user.info.profile).
The user's username (scope user.info.profile).
Number of followers, int64 (scope user.info.stats).
Number of accounts the user follows, int64 (scope user.info.stats).
Total likes received across all of the user's videos, int64 (scope user.info.stats).
Total number of publicly posted videos, int64 (scope user.info.stats).
Error object returned with every response.
"ok" on success; any other value (for example scope_not_authorized, access_token_invalid, rate_limit_exceeded) means the request failed.
Human-readable description of the error; empty on success.
Unique ID of the request, used when contacting TikTok support.

endpoints.title: List Videos
endpoints.description: Returns a paginated list of the authorized user's own public video posts, newest first (sorted by create_time descending). It cannot list another user's videos and does not search TikTok. Up to 20 videos per page; use the returned cursor while has_more is true. Requires the video.list scope.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated Video Object fields to return (for example id,title,cover_image_url). The reference page shows fields only in its example request (it has no separate parameter table), and the Display API guide always sends it.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Pagination cursor (int64). If the previous response had has_more = true, pass its cursor to get the next page. The value is a UTC Unix timestamp in milliseconds, so a custom value returns videos posted before that time.

parameters.name: max_count
parameters.description: Maximum number of videos returned per page (int32).

authentication.description: Requires a user access token obtained through Login Kit (OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow). The app must be approved for the listed scope(s) AND the signed-in TikTok user must grant them; users may grant only a subset of the requested scopes. Access tokens last 24 hours and are renewed with a refresh token (valid about 365 days).

pagination.details: Response has data.cursor and data.has_more. While has_more is true, send data.cursor as cursor in the next request. max_count is at most 20.

rateLimits.description: 600 requests per one-minute sliding window; exceeding it returns HTTP 429 with error code rate_limit_exceeded.

endpoints.title: oEmbed
endpoints.description: Converts the link of a TikTok video into embed markup and basic metadata (title, author, thumbnail) following the oEmbed specification. No access token or user login is documented for this endpoint. It returns no view, like or comment counts. Embed availability matches in-app availability: if a video is removed from TikTok, its embed stops working.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The TikTok video link, for example https://www.tiktok.com/@{username}/video/{video id}. A creator-profile URL is also accepted and returns the profile embed.

authentication.description: No authentication is documented; the endpoint is called with only the url parameter.

responseFields.description: oEmbed version ("1.0").
oEmbed resource type ("video").
Video caption.
URL of the creator's TikTok profile.
Creator's display name.
Width of the embed ("100%" in the documented example).
Height of the embed ("100%" in the documented example).
Embed markup: a blockquote plus a script tag that loads TikTok's embed.js.
Thumbnail width in pixels.
Thumbnail height in pixels.
Thumbnail image URL.

"TikTok".

endpoints.title: Query Creator Info
endpoints.description: Returns the signed-in creator's posting details: nickname, username, avatar, the privacy levels this creator may choose (privacy_level_options), whether comments/duet/stitch are disabled, and the maximum video length. TikTok's content sharing guidelines require apps to call it when rendering their Post to TikTok screen. Requires the video.publish scope. Rate limit: 20 requests per minute per user access token.

authentication.description: Requires a user access token obtained through Login Kit (OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow). The app must be approved for the listed scope(s) AND the signed-in TikTok user must grant them; users may grant only a subset of the requested scopes. Access tokens last 24 hours and are renewed with a refresh token (valid about 365 days).

rateLimits.description: 20 requests per minute per user access token (HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded).

responseFields.description: Creator information.
URL of the creator's avatar; valid for 2 hours.
The creator's unique ID (username).
The creator's display name.

Privacy levels this creator may use. Public accounts: PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, SELF_ONLY. Private accounts: FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR, MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS, SELF_ONLY. These describe the account; unaudited apps are still limited to SELF_ONLY.
true if the creator set comments to "No one".
true if the account is private or Duet is set to "No one". Ignore when posting photos only.
true if the account is private or Stitch is set to "No one". Ignore when posting photos only.
Longest video (in seconds) this creator may post.
Error object returned with every response.
"ok" on success; any other value (for example scope_not_authorized, access_token_invalid, rate_limit_exceeded) means the request failed.
Human-readable description of the error; empty on success.
Unique ID of the request, used when contacting TikTok support.

endpoints.title: Direct Post: Initialize Video Post
endpoints.description: Starts publishing a video directly to the signed-in creator's TikTok profile and returns a publish_id for status checks. Requires the video.publish scope and the Direct Post configuration. All content posted by unaudited API clients is restricted to private viewing: they may only use privacy_level SELF_ONLY, the posting accounts must be private, and at most 5 users may post per 24 hours (error unaudited_client_can_only_post_to_private_accounts otherwise). privacy_level must also be one of the privacy_level_options returned by Query Creator Info. Rate limit: 6 requests per minute per user token.

parameters.name: post_info
parameters.description: Post settings. privacy_level (string, required): PUBLIC_TO_EVERYONE | MUTUAL_FOLLOW_FRIENDS | FOLLOWER_OF_CREATOR | SELF_ONLY, and it must appear in the creator's privacy_level_options (unaudited clients: SELF_ONLY only). brand_content_toggle (boolean, REQUIRED): true if the post promotes a third-party brand, false otherwise. title (string, optional): caption, hashtags and mentions are parsed, max 2200 UTF-16 runes. Optional booleans: disable_duet, disable_stitch, disable_comment, brand_organic_toggle, is_aigc. video_cover_timestamp_ms (int32, optional): frame used as the cover.

parameters.name: source_info
parameters.description: Where the video comes from. source (string, required): FILE_UPLOAD or PULL_FROM_URL. For PULL_FROM_URL send video_url, a public URL on a domain or URL prefix the developer has verified. For FILE_UPLOAD send video_size, chunk_size and total_chunk_count, then PUT the file to the returned upload_url.

authentication.description: Requires a user access token obtained through Login Kit (OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow). The app must be approved for the listed scope(s) AND the signed-in TikTok user must grant them; users may grant only a subset of the requested scopes. Access tokens last 24 hours and are renewed with a refresh token (valid about 365 days). The app must be approved for video.publish and have Direct Post enabled.

availability.note: Unaudited clients: content is restricted to private (SELF_ONLY) viewing until the app passes TikTok's audit.

rateLimits.description: 6 requests per minute per user access token (HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded). Creators also have a daily Direct Post cap (error spam_risk_too_many_posts).

responseFields.description: Response data.
Identifier of this post (max 64 characters); used to check status.
Upload destination (max 256 characters), returned only when source is FILE_UPLOAD; valid for one hour.
Error object returned with every response.
"ok" on success; any other value (for example scope_not_authorized, access_token_invalid, rate_limit_exceeded) means the request failed.
Human-readable description of the error; empty on success.
Unique ID of the request, used when contacting TikTok support.

endpoints.title: Upload: Initialize Video Upload to Inbox
endpoints.description: Sends a video to the signed-in creator's TikTok inbox as a draft WITHOUT publishing it. The creator must open the inbox notification in the TikTok app to finish editing and post it. Requires the video.upload scope. At most 5 pending shares per user in any 24-hour period (error spam_risk_too_many_pending_share). Rate limit: 6 requests per minute per user token.

parameters.name: source_info
parameters.description: source (string, required): FILE_UPLOAD or PULL_FROM_URL. FILE_UPLOAD requires video_size, chunk_size and total_chunk_count; PULL_FROM_URL requires video_url on a verified domain or URL prefix.

authentication.description: Requires a user access token obtained through Login Kit (OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow). The app must be approved for the listed scope(s) AND the signed-in TikTok user must grant them; users may grant only a subset of the requested scopes. Access tokens last 24 hours and are renewed with a refresh token (valid about 365 days).

rateLimits.description: 6 requests per minute per user access token (HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded).

responseFields.description: Response data.
Identifier used to track the upload (max 64 characters).
Upload destination for FILE_UPLOAD (max 256 characters); valid for one hour.
Error object returned with every response.
"ok" on success; any other value (for example scope_not_authorized, access_token_invalid, rate_limit_exceeded) means the request failed.
Human-readable description of the error; empty on success.
Unique ID of the request, used when contacting TikTok support.

endpoints.title: Get Post Status
endpoints.description: Returns the current processing stage of a post started by Direct Post or Upload, identified by its publish_id. Processing is asynchronous; public posts also pass moderation (usually about a minute, sometimes hours). Requires video.publish or video.upload. Rate limit: 30 requests per minute per user token.

parameters.name: publish_id
parameters.description: The publish_id returned when the post or upload was initialized.

authentication.description: Requires a user access token obtained through Login Kit (OAuth 2.0 authorization code flow). The app must be approved for the listed scope(s) AND the signed-in TikTok user must grant them; users may grant only a subset of the requested scopes. Access tokens last 24 hours and are renewed with a refresh token (valid about 365 days). Either scope is sufficient.

pagination.details: Single object; call again (poll) to see later stages, or configure webhooks.

rateLimits.description: 30 requests per minute per user access token (HTTP 429 rate_limit_exceeded).

responseFields.description: Status data.
Current stage. PROCESSING_UPLOAD (FILE_UPLOAD only), PROCESSING_DOWNLOAD (PULL_FROM_URL only), SEND_TO_USER_INBOX (upload flow), PUBLISH_COMPLETE, FAILED.
Reason for failure, for example file_format_check_failed, duration_check_failed, video_pull_failed, spam_risk_too_many_posts.
Post IDs (int64), returned only for public posts that passed moderation. Spelling is TikTok's.
Bytes uploaded so far (FILE_UPLOAD).
Bytes downloaded so far (PULL_FROM_URL).
Error object returned with every response.
"ok" on success; any other value (for example scope_not_authorized, access_token_invalid, rate_limit_exceeded) means the request failed.
Human-readable description of the error; empty on success.
Unique ID of the request, used when contacting TikTok support.

endpoints.title: Research API: Query Videos
endpoints.description: RESTRICTED. Searches public TikTok videos from any creator by conditions such as hashtag_name, keyword, username or region_code within a date range of at most 30 days. Research API only: access is limited to approved researchers at eligible academic institutions or not-for-profit research organizations in specific regions, working on a non-commercial basis with an approved research proposal. Creators, advertisers and commercial apps are not eligible. Default daily limit 1,000 requests.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated Research Video Object fields to return, such as id,video_description,create_time.

parameters.name: query
parameters.description: Object with and / or / not lists of conditions {field_name, operation, field_values}. field_name: create_date, username, region_code, video_id, hashtag_name, keyword, music_id, effect_id, video_length, view_count, comment_count. operation: EQ, IN, GT, GTE, LT, LTE.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: Lower bound of video creation date, UTC, format YYYYMMDD.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: Upper bound of video creation date, UTC, YYYYMMDD; no more than 30 days after start_date.

parameters.name: max_count
parameters.description: Number of videos to return.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Index to start retrieving results from.

parameters.name: search_id
parameters.description: Identifier of a cached search, used to fetch more results for the same criteria.

parameters.name: is_random
parameters.description: If true, returns 1 to 100 matching videos in random order.

authentication.description: Requires a client access token for an approved Research API client with the research.data.basic scope. A research client is only generated after TikTok approves a research application; a regular developer account is not sufficient.

pagination.details: Use cursor and search_id from the response while has_more is true.

availability.note: Research API only: access is limited to approved researchers at eligible academic institutions or not-for-profit research organizations in specific regions, working on a non-commercial basis with an approved research proposal. scenarios.title: Creator Portfolio Header
scenarios.goal: A student-run portfolio website lets student video creators connect their TikTok account. Once connected, the top of the creator's portfolio page shows their TikTok display name, profile picture, follower count and the total number of likes their videos have received.

requirements.description: The creator's TikTok display name
A URL for the creator's profile picture
The creator's follower count
Total likes received across the creator's videos

constraints: Creators sign in with Login Kit. To keep permissions minimal, the app's authorization request asks only for the user.info.basic and user.info.stats scopes (user.info.profile is NOT requested).
The app already holds the signed-in creator's access token.
Request only data the page needs.

acceptedPlans.label: One profile request with scope-matched fields

steps.purpose: Read the signed-in creator's name, avatar and two stats in one request.

fields.note: Any one avatar field (avatar_url, avatar_url_100 or avatar_large_url) also satisfies r2; extra user.info.basic or user.info.stats fields are acceptable.

acceptedPlans.notes: display_name and avatar_url need user.info.basic; follower_count and likes_count need user.info.stats. Both scopes were requested.

rejectedPlans.reason: bio_description and is_verified belong to user.info.profile, which this app never requests, so the token is not authorized for them.
video_count is the number of public videos, not likes. Total likes is likes_count.
Returns video objects only (no display name, avatar or follower count). Adding up like_count would also miss non-public videos and require paging; likes_count already holds the total.
Part of the Content Posting API: needs the video.publish scope (not requested) and has no follower or like counts.
Research API is restricted to approved non-commercial researchers; a portfolio site cannot get a research client.

explanation.summary: Get User Info returns the authorized creator's own profile. The fields parameter decides which properties come back, and every field is tied to a scope: display_name and avatar_url to user.info.basic, follower_count and likes_count to user.info.stats. Because the app requests only those two scopes, profile-scope fields such as bio_description must be left out.
keyIdeas: The fields query parameter is required; the response contains only the fields you list.
Each field needs a specific scope, so the scopes your app requests limit which fields you may ask for.
likes_count (total likes) and video_count (number of public videos) are different statistics; read the descriptions.
Counts are int64 values, so a Java long/Long is a safe type.

distractorNotes.note: Gives per-video data, not profile totals.
Shows the creator's nickname and avatar for posting screens, but requires video.publish.
Has follower counts for any username, but only approved researchers can use it.

notes: Illustrative sample: names, IDs, URLs, counts and log IDs are fictional. Property names, nesting and types follow the official TikTok for Developers reference (verified 2026-10-17).
Only the requested fields are returned.

unnecessaryFields.reason: Empty on success; only used for error handling.

acceptableVariations: Counts stored as Long (boxed) or int.
avatar_url_100 or avatar_large_url used instead of avatar_url.

parameterVariations.description: Which second statistic the header shows next to followers.

options.label: number of accounts the creator follows

requirementOverrides.r4: Number of accounts the creator follows

options.label: number of public videos

requirementOverrides.r4: Number of videos the creator has publicly posted

options.rejectedPlanNotes: video_count becomes correct; the video_count rejection no longer applies.

scenarios.learningTarget: Choose fields-parameter values that cover the requirements while staying within the scopes the app requested.

instructionalReview.learn: Fields in TikTok's user endpoint are gated by individual scopes; the request must match what was authorized.
instructionalReview.decision: Which comma-separated fields to request given only user.info.basic and user.info.stats.
instructionalReview.solvableWithoutDocs: Without the field table, students cannot know that likes_count exists, that it differs from video_count, or that bio_description needs another scope.
instructionalReview.distractorsPlausible: List Videos looks like a way to total likes; Query Creator Info shows a nickname and avatar; the Research user lookup has follower counts.
instructionalReview.otherValidPlans: Any avatar field variant; extra fields from the two granted scopes.
instructionalReview.distinctFrom: Closest: spotify-monthly-recap (enum mapping). Here the decision is mapping requirements to field names under a scope limit, not choosing an enum value.
instructionalReview.difficultyNote: Difficulty 1: one request, but scope reasoning is new.
instructionalReview.explanationTeaches: Explains the field-to-scope mapping and the likes_count vs video_count distinction.

scenarios.title: Complete Video Portfolio Grid
scenarios.goal: A creator portfolio app shows a grid of EVERY public video the signed-in creator has posted, not just the most recent ones. Each tile shows the video's cover image, title, length and posting date. Some creators have hundreds of videos.

requirements.description: Every public video the creator has posted (the complete set)
Each video's title
Each video's cover image URL
Each video's length
Each video's posting date

constraints: The creator signed in with Login Kit and granted the video.list scope.
The app does not know any video IDs in advance.
Use as few requests as possible, because the app rebuilds every creator's grid each night.
scenarios.efficiencyConstraint: Use as few requests as possible, because the app rebuilds every creator's grid each night.

acceptedPlans.label: Largest pages, follow the cursor while has_more

steps.purpose: Get the first (newest) page of up to 20 videos.

conditionalSteps.purpose: Fetch the next page; repeat with each new cursor until has_more is false.
conditionalSteps.notes: Each repetition uses the cursor returned by the page just received.

acceptedPlans.notes: The list is sorted newest first, so paging walks back through the creator's history.

rejectedPlans.reason: One page holds at most 20 videos; ignoring has_more drops older videos (r1).
Valid, but the default page size of 10 needs twice as many requests as max_count 20.
max_count has a maximum of 20.
Requires video IDs, which the app does not have.
Restricted to approved non-commercial researchers.
video_count says how many videos exist but returns no video data.

explanation.summary: List Videos returns the creator's public videos newest first, at most 20 per page. Each response carries data.cursor and data.has_more; while has_more is true the app sends the cursor back to get the next page. Asking for max_count 20 minimizes the number of requests.
keyIdeas: Cursor paging: copy data.cursor from one response into the cursor body field of the next request.
has_more is the stop signal; a fixed number of requests is not.
Default page size (10) and maximum (20) are documented; choose the maximum when you need everything.

scenarios.title: Spotlight Video on a Creator Page

requirements.description: Embed the creator's chosen spotlight video as a playable player
The video's caption/title
A thumbnail image URL for the page preview

constraints: When the creator chose the spotlight, the app saved both the video's ID and its share link (share_url).
The creator authorized video.list when connecting TikTok, but visitors to the page never log in.
The page should keep working with as little dependence on the creator's login as possible.
Show the spotlight with a single request, because the page is rebuilt for every visitor.
scenarios.efficiencyConstraint: Show the spotlight with a single request, because the page is rebuilt for every visitor.

acceptedPlans.label: oEmbed from the saved share link

steps.purpose: Get embed HTML, caption and thumbnail without any token.

acceptedPlans.notes: No access token needed, so the spotlight keeps working even if the creator's token lapses or they disconnect the app.

acceptedPlans.label: Query Videos with the creator's token

Restricted to approved researchers.

Query Videos returns embed_html, title and cover_image_url but needs the creator's valid access token with video.list. Under the stated preference for minimal dependence on the creator's login, oEmbed is preferred; Query Videos is still correct and becomes necessary if statistics are needed.

oEmbed returns no statistics; Query Videos can add view_count, like_count, etc.
cover_image_url expires after 6 hours, so a stored Display API cover goes stale; oEmbed returns a thumbnail_url in each response.
Visitors never log in; any token used belongs to the creator.

Restricted research product.

scenarios.goal: The school science department wants a hallway screen that automatically finds the newest public TikTok videos from anyone tagged #sciencefair, shows each one's view count, and also plays any specific video a teacher pastes in. Show the view count of each found video
Embed a specific video when a teacher pastes its TikTok link

constraints: The creators of the videos have not connected their TikTok accounts to the school's app.
The school is not an approved Research API client and its project is not an academic research study.
Use only capabilities the school's app can actually get.

unsupportedRequirements.reason: Searching all public TikTok videos by hashtag is only offered by the Research API's Query Videos, which is limited to approved non-commercial researchers at eligible institutions. Display API endpoints only return the authorizing user's own videos. Hashtag search in the TikTok app is a consumer feature, not a developer endpoint.
View counts are available through List/Query Videos only for videos owned by a user who authorized the app (video.list), or through the restricted Research API. oEmbed returns no statistics.
